name: Teresa Laura Cicco
bioAdditions: Teresa Laura was baptized on 3 September 1755, daughter of Tommaso Cicco and Anna Ianni (S1). She married Giovanni Colosimo on 10 November 1777 (S2). Her parents are new to the tree. She died before February 1833, when her husband was buried as a widower. Her 1822 death (tree) is not in the civil or parish index; civil deaths for 1815-1822 are not indexed.
